lead: An attack on a long non-ASCII string pays one pass over it per `Core` call in the proof binary, whatever the member does.
body: `NvsStr::text_of` runs a `debug_assert!` UTF-8 check on every string argument, and std's check is fast only on ASCII, so 100000 calls over 8 MB of "é" never finish even for `Core\Str::isEmpty`, while the same text of "x" takes a fraction of a second. Size a hostile step over accented text by bytes × calls for the debug build (1 MB × 5000 is about two seconds), and time an algorithmic fix on an ASCII subject or the release binary.
